'''Aile Jafar''' is an archipelago that is controlled by the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' and [[Amayar]]. The islands are situated just west of [[Tarabon]]. The [[Seanchan]] currently occupy the islands.

==Recent activities==
The ''[[Wavedancer]]'', an ''Atha'an Miere'' [[raker]], sailed to Aile Jafar after leaving [[Tanchico]].{{ref/book|4|39}}
